race.comment: BIVACCO (2) resumes and makes his stable debut for the Archibald's after two trials. Has been patchy throughout his career but shoulders peaks that stack up strongly for a race of this calibre. SIR DON (6) is another that will find this a bit easier and McColm's claim offsets the drop in grade. In the mix. Finished 2.5 lengths from the winner in fifth last start after being prominent at the turn over 1350m at Ipswich so he was close by. LA PROFECIA (2) ran below expectations last time at Gold Coast but wasn't miles away finishing sixth and beaten 4 lengths. Likely improver with top-three prospects.
